about: Strings in the patcher's companion DLLs and exe patches that scripts/scan_patch_text.py finds but that are deliberately NOT in the translation template, each rule with its reason. tests/test_translations_patch_coverage.py fails on any found string that is neither in data/translations/patcher_strings.json nor matched here. A rule: files (globs, repo-relative), optional functions (globs on the function or array a literal is in), optional match (a regular expression on the text); patch_files for exe-patch texts.

rules.reason: Log and export writers: the Births, Deaths, History, Arrived, Unaccounted and Statistics logs and the Family Tree / Statistics data the patcher's own tools read back. Logs and files stay in the game's English (src/vv_translations.py: never for logs or files the patcher writes) so the patcher can parse them and every language's logs match.
Log lines, sidecar file formats and save-folder names shared by the companions (logs and files stay English; the patcher reads them back).
The quit-time Repair / last-names check's sidecar lines and answers (a file the patcher reads back), never shown.
Windows class names, the Roman numeral digits and a label fragment searched for in a window's text: code, never shown.
A game's title: the name of its folder under Documents\LDW (and of the patcher's save folders), never shown.

Cause of Death's logs (Deaths, Graves Logged, Arrived, Gone, Unaccounted, Custom Island Event Deaths) and the grave-title words it writes into them. The words it DRAWS in the game (the cause words, the epitaphs) are in the template and looked up by key.
Cause of Death's log-only words: the not-recorded and unknown-code causes are written to the Deaths log only (the grave popup draws a cause only when one was recorded), and the no-grave notes.
Island Events writes the island events' log (each event, its choice and every changed field); logs stay English.
The translation file format's own words (plural rule names, header names, game titles to check the @game row): compared with the file, never shown.
Font face names, Windows folder and registry names the Unicode companions load letters from, and the long-names file: names, never shown.

Sidecar file headers, folder names and log lines of these companions (Last Names, Number Duplicate Names, Original Look, Head Look, VV2 totems' store, Game Log); "`s totem" is the game's own text, compared with it.
Builders Fix Huts' log values (what a builder found: nothing / started).
Parentage's cross-check log and its file notes, the name-change log line, a set-aside file's note, and the VV1_PROBE debug line (compiled only into a debug build, never shipped).
Origins' file names and file-format magic (the atlas, the mask sidecar).
Story / Cheat Upgrades' save-folder names and the log block of a custom event's parents (logs stay English).
A dialog resource's FONT (a Windows typeface name) and Story Upgrades' Custom Titles folder name: names, never shown.
rules.match: ^(Segoe UI|MS Shell Dlg|MS Shell Dlg 2|Tahoma|Custom Titles)$

rules.reason: Names written into a villager's record (the default father Joey / Joey Joerson, an unknown father's "Unknown"): a name is save data, never a translated word (the logs, the Family Tree and Matchmaker compare it), so it stays as written.
An exe patch's name for a companion DLL or one of its exports: code, never shown.
